summary: Fase 54 - Session Resilience: Frontend testing complete. CRITICAL USER STORY 1 (silent token refresh) PASSED 100%. All core session management features working correctly: expired token triggers exactly ONE /api/auth/refresh, session warning banner correctly absent during normal operation, work preservation returns user to exact page after re-login, session notices are human-friendly without leaked internal terms, portal session expiry is honest and customer-friendly.

backend_issues.notes: Backend already verified with 75 PASS tests (poc_54.py), 68 gate checks (verify_session_resilience.py), 36 mutation tests. No backend testing required per agent-to-agent context.

passed_tests: US-1 (CRITICAL): Silent token refresh - expired token planted, exactly ONE POST /api/auth/refresh occurred, token automatically refreshed in localStorage, user NOT redirected to login, customers page loaded with data, session warning banner correctly ABSENT

US-2: Session expiry with work preservation - redirected to login when session truly expired, session notice explains 'berakhir karena sudah cukup lama', return-to hint mentions 'daftar lead', after re-login returned to /leads (not home), table has same 25 rows (work preserved)
US-3: One-time return note - manually navigating to /login while logged in redirects to home (not back to /leads), no bouncing
US-4: Voluntary logout - logout via profile menu lands on /login WITHOUT session-expired notice (correct behavior)
US-5: Multi-role refresh - sales@sipro.co.id can access /leads, access to /tax shows humane denial WITHOUT leaked permission names like 'tax:view'

US-6: Portal honest expiry - portal login with OTP +6281250000502/000000 successful, after token invalidation redirected to portal login, session notice is customer-friendly mentioning 'OTP/kode', NO panels failing individually
REGRESSION: All main pages (/, /leads, /customers, /deals, /finance, /tax) load without React errors, no '[object Object]', no leaked internal terms (localStorage, JWT, permission names)
REGRESSION: Lead profile accessible to finance@sipro.co.id with multiple tabs, no false 'tidak diberi akses ke data lead' message
